## 5. Interaction Flow

The interaction flow for Individual Service Assurance follows the IAADE sequence (Perception, Analysis, Decision, Execution). Functional modules exchange KPIs, events, and recommendations to ensure closed-loop assurance of service quality.

[Figure: Interaction Flow for Individual Service Assurance Scenario Solution Package]

### Step 1 – Perception (KPI Collection):

The network and service elements periodically report performance KPIs and QoE indicators to the Service Assurance Agent.

### Step 2 & 3 – Analysis (QoE Evaluation & Diagnosis):

The Assurance Agent identifies poor QoE, correlates relevant KPIs and faults, and performs automated diagnosis to generate potential optimization solutions.

### Step 4 – Decision (Recommendation & Root Cause Correlation):

Recommendations are formulated, with associated KPIs and root cause information. These are reported to the orchestration layer and ticket management systems for traceability.

### Step 5 – Execution (Closed-Loop Action):

The Assurance Agent triggers corrective actions & network change agent execute on NE
